## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Broad sector strength (9/11) vs neutral risk ratios (VXX → flat; HYG/LQD → flat) provide two independent confirmations for a neutral regime.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit conditions stable: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND, LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND — net → flat. Volatility muted: VXX (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND but direction → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Stocks vs bonds mixed: SPY (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION while TLT (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND — overall neutral/balanced financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals and defensives leading: XLE (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +17.99%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while XLK (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -3.69%) BELOW TREND is lagging — style: cyclical/value tilt.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US flat: SPY (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.15%) CORRECTION; EM outperforming: EEM (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND, China FXI (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -0.15%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation waning: IBIT (1W: -16.45% | 1M: -23.01%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -5.96% | 1M: -13.22%) BELOW TREND are weak, while small caps IWM (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +3.73%) ABOVE TREND show selective risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Gold reflation bid: GLD (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +11.30%) ABOVE TREND; base/industrial commodities mixed with CPER (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.92%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy strength intact: XLE (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +17.99%) ABOVE TREND and commodity-led ETFs (TAN (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +14.40%) ABOVE TREND) showing momentum; watch the short-term pullbacks in oil proxies BNO (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +14.23%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -21.48% | 1M: +12.65%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (9/11) with XLE, XLP, GLD ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Multiple commodity ETFs and SPY show 1W vs 1M mismatch (BNO, USO, UNG, CPER, SPY) — classify as MINOR divergence concentrated in commodities.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure: XLE (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +17.99%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +14.77%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to tech momentum: XLK (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -3.69%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -2.30%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral-to-anchoring with TLT (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +17.99%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND for continued cyclical leadership.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -3.69%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -2.30%) BELOW TREND for persistent tech weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +11.30%) ABOVE TREND if risk-off breadth narrows.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -21.48% | 1M: +12.65%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +14.23%) CORRECTION — watch for short-term mean reversion.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health checkpoint); XLK/QQQ relative ratio 2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive supports risk stability even as headline risk ratios are neutral. Cyclicals and defensives (XLE, XLP, XLB) showing strength while tech (XLK, QQQ) and crypto (IBIT) remain key weakness risks to monitor.
